name: closing-the-last-tab-fades-the-tint-away
description: With ambilight on and one dark red-iconed tab colouring the window, Cmd+W closes it, and with no tab left the glow band and the backdrop go back to the space's own colour. The window logs the clearing, and the band beside the card changes between the two captures.

actions.note: the sampler settles on the page and the brand
